evidence: Workbook row: 'The agent's world has the inputs and the ask, but no finished copy of the deliverable.' Skill procedure (quality-checks.md:71): /app holds only .gitkeep; no starter/skeleton/schema/route list/partial UI in the agent image; nothing under /instructions reproduces criterion text or the rubric. (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (both sha256 0a75419e...67d1). It COPYs only instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15), creates /app, git-inits it and commits only .gitkeep (lines 17-23). No COPY of solution/ or tests/. environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md (no hidden files). task.toml has no [environment].docker_image (prebuilt image) that could carry the golden. (2) assets/seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c80...3740, identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is expected: it is the input) contains only input records: stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, 10 users, 3 jobs, 16 applications (id/job/candidate/source/stage/position, rejected_from/reject_reason on APP-301), 127 messages, 3 notes, 6 read markers, plus a generated_note pointing to the rules file. No derived outputs: no activity log, precomputed unread/seen results, card versions, SQL schema, route list or UI. (3) /instructions: hireops_rules.md:3-5 says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are up to you'; it describes behaviour (status codes 401/403/404/409 as rules, not an endpoint list). integration.md is the template runtime text plus a symlink paragraph (lines 16-19); no code or schema. Hygiene grep (judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|glm|claude|/tests|sentinel|CHANGE_ME|TODO) over instruction.md and environment/ returned no hits. A 7-word shingle scan of instruction.md + both notes against all 12 tests/**/*.toml|*.md files found only three short natural overlaps (max 8 words: 'its most recent 30 messages oldest of', '30 at a time in order and', 'says the card was changed and by whom'), which are requirement statements, not reproduced criterion text. (4) Colderwater lessons checked for this row: none of lessons 1-21 concern environment leakage directly; lesson 1/12 (hidden requirements, checklist-style notes) were checked only insofar as notes reproduce criteria — they do not at length; row-1 voice is out of scope here. Adversarial: a broken app cannot pass by copying a shipped starter because none exists in the image; a conforming alternative is not penalised by this row since nothing ships that constrains layout. Limits: static source inspection; I did not build the agent image (no Docker per assignment). raw-evidence-index.json covers golden/verifier runs, not the agent image, but the Dockerfile is the template's unchanged bytes so no runtime measurement is required for this row.
